prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Paint the supplied paint_mask_guide.png exactly according to this brief. The guide is the edit target; design_reference.png is material/detail reference; icon_x8.png is original colour reference (magenta is background).
Output ONE transparent PNG, 1536x2048 or nearest 3:4 size. Preserve exact guide layout: three columns by FOUR rows of equal square cells. Rows 1-2: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty. Rows 3-4 duplicate these views for material masks. All ten objects must retain EXACTLY their guide position, scale, orientation, silhouette, openings and geometry. Paint grey objects only; do not enlarge, move, reshape or redesign. The simple upright hoop model is authoritative; express reference braided silver grooves and gold edges as painted surface details only.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colour of Prize Ring, source-faithful upright hoop plane. Use silver/steel hoop with diagonal groove details, golden edges and mount, silver bezel, ruby red gemstone with warm cream golden central area based on reference colours. Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow reference scaled to each existing view. NO baked lighting, shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections, sparkle or glow; remove reference lighting effects in favour of base colour.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: same five guide silhouettes. FLAT pure #FF0000 for ALL metal including gold and silver and the whole hoop/bezel; FLAT pure #000000 for ALL visible gemstone areas. Black gemstone is opaque black, never a transparent hole. Every silhouette pixel belongs to one of these two colours only, no shading, texture, outlines or antialiased colour blends inside.
Background and every gap/opening fully transparent. Column 3 of row 2 and column 3 of row 4 entirely empty transparent. No text, grid, outlines, ground or outside aura. Geometry and layout accuracy take priority over embellishment.
CORRECTION: Previous attempt incorrectly redesigned the ring silhouette into ornate shoulders and leaked red mask speckles across background. Start from ORIGINAL grey guide, not a new ring drawing. Keep the plain straight rectangular cross-section hoop, simple cylindrical bezel and dome EXACTLY. Do not add sculpted shoulders, cords, lumps or any geometry. The FRONT view's dome is partly occluded by the hoop exactly as grey guide. Surface braid pattern must be flat paint contained inside existing plain hoop outline. Mask shapes must match ORIGINAL guide silhouettes exactly, absolutely no dots or flecks outside shapes or inside ring openings. Preserve existing transparent background pixel-for-pixel.
